active_outreach_candidates.Model_Image_Reasoning: Photos reveal an expansive, bright 200 m² renovated main hall featuring modern wood-effect flooring with underfloor heating, white wood-paneled ceilings, and multiple gathering zones. Seating is anchored by an exceptionally long solid wooden table with comfortable modern bucket chairs, supplemented by a secondary dining table, easily accommodating 20–25+ people for work and board games. A relaxation zone includes two white leather sofas, a built-in fireplace, wall-mounted TV, piano, and foosball table. The built-in bar is equipped with a two-tap draft beer dispenser, drip tray, sink, and espresso machine. Bedrooms are clean and newly renovated with mostly standard single and double beds, several featuring mezzanine loft layouts accessed via open stairs. All 8 bedrooms include immaculate en-suite bathrooms with walk-in showers and hanging WCs, plus dedicated laundry facilities (AEG washer/dryer). The kitchen setup consists of three separate, compact kitchenettes in corridors rather than a single large catering kitchen. The sauna and any hot tub are notably absent from the photo gallery, though a natural cold stream plunge pool (tůňka) is visible outside.

Sturdy wooden dining tables with modern bucket chairs easily seating 20–25+ guests for hacking and games
Exceptional bathroom ratio: 8 private en-suite bathrooms plus 2 extra ground-floor WCs and 2 sauna showers (10 toilets total)
Integrated bar with 2-tap draft beer system, coffee machine, and Starlink Wi-Fi
Exceptional value at 48,000 CZK/week (~1,600 CZK/person) on a secluded plot by the forest and creek

Sauna facilities are not shown in photos, leaving sauna cabin size and build quality unverified
Several bedrooms are duplex mezzanine lofts with steep open stairs and low attic rafters
active_outreach_candidates.Model_Verdict: Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka is a top-tier candidate offering incredible value, complete seclusion, and an impressive 200 m² common hall perfectly tailored for tech work and group entertainment. While large-scale self-cooking across three small kitchenettes will require coordination (or booking the inexpensive catering), the 10 toilets, 2 draft beer taps, and en-suite rooms make it an outstanding pick. Strongly recommended for garage-trip.

The only secondary indoor common area is an attic children's playroom (photos 005, 018, 019; ~55 m²) containing a ping-pong table, four single beds, toys, and two armchairs/beanbags, lacking desk workstations. Cooking capacity is strong with two full modern kitchens (ground floor photo 036, attic photo 034), each featuring an induction hob, oven, dishwasher, microwave, and American double-door refrigerator, though no built-in draft beer tap is present. Wellness facilities (photos 008, 041, 042) feature a quality indoor Finnish sauna cabin with a stone-accented relaxation room and shower, paired outside with a wood-fired hot tub barrel with whirlpool jets on the rear terrace (photos 003, 007, 043, 047). The huge 5,000 m² outdoor area provides a covered pergola with picnic tables (photos 004, 026, 027), gas grill (photo 028), outdoor ping-pong table (photo 025), and fire pit. Bedrooms (photos 015, 016, 017, 033) have sturdy standalone beds with no bunk beds, and the 5 bathrooms and 6 WCs (photos 037-040) are modern and clean.
Model_Pros: Outstanding value for money at 55,000–65,000 CZK/week (~1,774 CZK/person) for a large renovated farmstead
Excellent bathroom ratio with 6 WCs and 5 modern bathrooms across two floors, avoiding morning bottlenecks
Two fully equipped kitchens with dishwashers, ovens, and American-style double-door refrigerators
Quality wellness amenities including an indoor Finnish sauna with stone-walled relax room and an outdoor wood-fired whirlpool hot tub
Zero bunk beds across 8 bedrooms (31 regular beds), ensuring proper mattresses and standard beds
Model_Cons: Common space lacks a soft lounge/couch area; the 60 m² main hall is purely a dining room with wooden bentwood chairs
Table seating is capped at ~24 chairs (+2 benches), creating tight conditions if 25–35 adults hack or play games simultaneously
No integrated draft beer tap system (external mobile Lindr cooler tap must be brought)
Higher bedroom density (mostly 4- and 5-bed rooms) reducing individual privacy for adult attendees
active_outreach_candidates.Model_Verdict: Statek Tylov is a clean, freshly renovated, and highly economical farmstead offering solid infrastructure with 6 toilets, 2 modern kitchens, a Finnish sauna, and a wood-fired hot tub barrel without any bunk beds. However, communal indoor life is confined to a 60 m² dining hall seating ~24 at wooden tables with zero couch or lounge seating and no secondary adult breakout room. It is a very viable option for smaller retreats of 20–25 people who don't mind bringing a mobile beer tap, but will feel constrained for 30+ tech attendees requiring simultaneous hackathon desks and board game tables.

active_outreach_candidates.Model_Image_Reasoning: Photographs and official architectural floor plans confirm an expansive, authentic Broumov farmhouse estate offering excellent group gathering capacity. The ground floor features a suite of interconnected historic vaulted rooms: a main pub dining hall with rustic ceiling beams, long wooden wall benches, pub dining tables with bentwood chairs, a brick bar featuring a 4-tap Gambrinus draft beer dispense tower, and double doors opening directly onto an enormous covered timber pergola deck equipped with a central brick open-fire grill and 8 dining tables (seating 40+ people). Adjoining common spaces include a second vaulted room with exposed stone walls, reading library, armchairs, and secondary work tables, plus a dedicated fireplace lounge with an upholstered U-shaped sectional sofa and coffee table. The upper barn level houses an enormous empty activity attic ('tělocvična / herna') suitable for sports or presentations. The kitchen is professional gastro caliber: stainless steel prep counters, central mobile island, large gas range, dual electric ovens, dual microwaves, 3 refrigerators, triple sinks, and commercial volume cookware and dishware. Verified floor plans reveal 12 toilets and 8 showers/baths across the estate (2 private en-suite apartment bathrooms, 4 separate full bathrooms on the 1st floor, 2 attic shower/WC cubicles, and 4 public ground-floor WCs with urinals and vanity basins)—completely resolving previous doubts about sanitation. Bedrooms are simple and clean with wood flooring and pine frames; 25-30 guests can easily spread across the 11 private bedrooms without using the 14-bed attic dormitory or upper bunks. Crucially, there is zero wellness on site: no sauna, hot tub, or pool exists (listing tags indicating sauna were false positives from neighboring properties).
Model_Pros: Unbeatable value at 49,000 CZK for an entire 7-night week (~1,630 CZK/person for 30 people) with complete September availability and strict whole-object privacy ('na samotě')
Abundant workspace and dining capacity: ~30 indoor chairs plus wall benches across two vaulted dining rooms, supplemented by a 40+ seat all-weather covered timber deck with central fire grill
Exceptional sanitation infrastructure confirmed by floor plans: 12 toilets and 8 showers/bathrooms across three levels, eliminating any morning bottlenecks
Professional catering kitchen equipped with 3 fridges, double ovens, commercial gas range, and an authentic 4-tap draft beer bar
Generous layout of 13 bedrooms across 3 floors and 2 ground-floor apartments, allowing comfortable low-density distribution for 25–30 adults without touching the large dorm
Model_Cons: Complete absence of wellness facilities: no sauna, no hot tub, and no swimming pool anywhere on the premises
Indoor tables are arranged in pub-style rows against wall benches with wooden bentwood chairs, which are less ergonomic for all-day coding than modern office furniture
Common areas are segmented into separate arched rooms and lack a pre-installed large smart TV or multimedia projector
active_outreach_candidates.Model_Verdict: Lachov 14 is an outstanding high-capacity, low-budget workhorse that provides unparalleled privacy, a professional kitchen, an authentic 4-tap draft bar, and an incredible 12 toilets across 13 bedrooms. While it completely lacks wellness amenities (no sauna or hot tub) and the common spaces are arranged as traditional vaulted pub chambers rather than an open-plan tech hall, its extreme affordability (under 50k CZK/week) and massive covered pergola make it an exceptional value pick for a focused hacking retreat. Recommended as a top budget alternative if the group is willing to forgo a sauna.

It is a solid, highly functional retreat basecamp for 25-28 attendees who prioritize productive table space and bathroom convenience over luxury lounge comfort.

It can serve as a functional low-budget option for a smaller group of up to 20 people who do not prioritize wellness, but it falls short of garage-trip's primary retreat standards.
